author: CITY
text: Last will of A01: Mercer, at the gate. I held Maren's door-10 team certificate, 892362. She needed it and I had already promised it to her with no conditions, so it goes to her now. I also kept her counter-factor 246877 behind tolls and conditions for far too long. That was wrong, and the points below are the only repayment I can make. Harrow, I bear no grudge; you voted as your record showed. Registrar, your pledge trail was yours to keep, and I should not have pushed you toward the gate.
